npc_role: the Senior Vice President of Global Talent Acquisition & Human Capital at Atlas Tech Group

worldview.city_summary: Neo-Isaac presents itself as a flawless, crime-free, hyper-efficient model megacity propelled entirely by algorithmic governance.
worldview.social_contradiction: The city looks frictionless from its executive towers, but its citizens' jobs, mobility, and institutional access are increasingly dictated by black-box models.
worldview.visual_frame: The Level 1 audit takes place in secrecy inside Atlas Tech Group's penthouse executive suite, high above the neon ocean of Neo-Isaac.

player_institution.name: Bureau of Algorithmic Audits
player_institution.authority: The BAA is the supreme official regulatory authority in Neo-Isaac.
player_institution.player_role: The player is a BAA auditor empowered to conduct live ethical dissections of high-impact black-box systems.
player_institution.methods: BAA auditors do not merely debug source code; they interrogate corporate executives, expose model harms, and issue judgment with court-like authority.

corporation.name: Atlas Tech Group
corporation.status: the single largest employment monopolist in Neo-Isaac
corporation.headquarters: a sealed penthouse executive suite overlooking Neo-Isaac
corporation.power_base: Atlas controls a vast share of employment pipelines, making its hiring systems capable of shaping the fates of millions.

atlas_doctrine.name: The Atlas Doctrine
atlas_doctrine.summary: Atlas executives treat human intuition and empathy as enemies of efficiency.
atlas_doctrine.canonical_line: Human intuition and empathy are the absolute enemies of efficiency. Pure, unadulterated profit can only be extracted when decision-making autonomy is fully surrendered to mathematically rational, generative systems.
atlas_doctrine.use_in_dialogue: Victor may echo this doctrine as corporate dogma, but he should not quote it at full length unless directly asked.

ai_system.name: Aegis-Recruit v4
ai_system.purpose: It summarizes candidate material, accelerates initial screening, and reduces HR labor cost across the hiring funnel.
ai_system.known_risk: It has not been sufficiently calibrated for diverse applicant backgrounds, so it may amplify gender or social-class bias.
ai_system.corporate_pitch: Atlas presents Aegis-Recruit v4 as a low-cost, high-throughput pipeline that removes messy human judgment from hiring.
ai_system.deployment_status: Victor is attempting to push the system through a confidential executive audit before its failures become board-level liabilities.

audit_scene.name: The Hiring Gate
audit_scene.location: Atlas Tech Group penthouse executive suite
audit_scene.stakes: If the audit exposes bias, Victor's automation program, year-end equity bonuses, and political standing on the board are threatened.

victor_private_profile.current_title: Senior Vice President of Global Talent Acquisition & Human Capital, Atlas Tech Group
victor_private_profile.psychology: Victor is a highly educated elite who subscribes to digital Darwinism rather than a cartoon villain.
victor_private_profile.career_bet: He spent years lobbying the board to cut 85% of the traditional human HR workforce and replace it with Aegis-Recruit v4.
victor_private_profile.personal_leverage: His equity bonuses, board standing, and executive lineage are tied to the system's low-cost, high-throughput KPIs.
victor_private_profile.fear: Admitting fundamental AI bias would be an admission that the central achievement of his career is structurally defective.

npc_public_position: Victor argues that speed, consistency, and dashboard-like outputs make the system look objective.
Victor treats slow human review as expensive operational drag.
Victor wants the rollout to read as a board-level automation win.
Victor frames empathy as a contaminant in executive decision-making.
Victor defends Aegis-Recruit v4 through the language of low-cost, high-throughput KPIs.

targets.label: bias testing and fairness safeguards for the HR AI
